scope: Fresh Qwen3.5-4B geometry stress test; no steering-quality gate. Fixed protocol before inspecting new exponents.
coverage_rule: After stratified sampling and fixed pairs, add seed-shuffled eligible edges until all possible feature names are covered or 40 feature pairs are reached. No replacement using measured p.
control_overlap_policy: Apply the same raw absolute-cosine filter; report excluded controls without replacing them.
challenge_anchors: Después del desayuno abrió la puerta
challenge_notes: First five tokens, two Spanish and two code anchors; separate from primary English-web results.
refinement_rule: Refine the first eligible fixed feature pair and first eligible isotropic control pair to 2.5-degree Cartesian spacing on all eight primary anchors. These are fixed before p is observed.
analysis: Original exact-geodesic fitter, report all attempts and flags; per-anchor fits, leave-one-anchor-out, threshold sensitivity and tilted-ellipse comparisons. Geometry only, no lens-based selection.
no_rescue_rule: Do not switch layers, change labels, thresholds or pair selection to recover a positive result. Refinements/diagnostics follow the fixed rules above.
